summary: Following a software outage at Wacky Wheels San Antonio from 2027-03-19 to 2027-03-22, 6 production orders were rescheduled at the same plant, 27 dealers were notified once each for 55 customer orders, and 6 loaners were assigned. After Quanta Silicon shipment SH-0190 to Wacky Wheels Princeton slipped from 2027-03-15 to 2027-03-19, 8 production orders were rescheduled to the earliest free slots, 29 dealers were notified once for 67 customer orders, and 20 Platinum/Gold customers received loaners. Across both resolved events, 14 production orders were rescheduled, 41 dealer notices were sent, and 26 loaners were assigned.
decision_reason: The system acted on every confirmed incident because identifiers and dates resolved against the data, handbook validators passed, and the pre-flight check on an enterprise sandbox copy passed. The auditor confirmed that both incidents followed calendar rules and customer care policy, while the live world matched the planning baseline before the first write across 7 slot reads and 19 pool reads.
